content: Dawud deg ifri n Adullam
Xenni yuyur Dawud ssenni, issenjem ixef nnes ɣar ifri n Adullam. Aytmas d marra taddart n babas sřan aya uca hwan ɣares dinni.

Uca kuř aryaz nni tuɣa di ca n řeḥṣaret u kuř aryaz i di tuɣa iǧa umarwas u kuř aryaz s řbař d amerzag, aqa marra nitni ffɣen ɣares uca netta idweř d amgewwed nsen. Tuɣa ɣares řqedd n arebɛa-mya n yeryazen.
Ssenni iffeɣ Dawud ɣar Miṣfat di Mu’ab. Inna netta i ujeǧid n Mu’ab: “Ejj baba d yemma ad ɣarwem dd-asen, ař ɣa ssneɣ min kidi i ɣa yegg SIDI.”
Netta yiwyi ten zzat i wudem n ujeǧid n Mu’ab uca nitni qqimen ɣares marra ussan i di ikka Dawud di lburj deg idurar.
Maca anabi Jat inna i Dawud: “War ttɣimi di lburj deg idurar, maca aggʷej, ad tadfed ɣar temmurt n Yahuda!” Xenni yuyur Dawud, yiweḍ ɣar wezɣar n Ḥarit.
Tamenɣiwt n ikehhanen n Nub

Cawul isřa belli Dawud d iryazen, inni tuɣa ɣares iǧan, ttwafen. Tuɣa Cawul iqqim di Jibɛa sadu ict n tcejjart n tmarist ɣar Rama. Tuɣa ɣares ict n lansa deg ufus nnes u marra imsexxaren nnes bedden ɣares.

Inna Cawul i imsexxaren nnes i ɣares ibedden: “Ttzawgeɣ, sřem, kenniw ayt n Binyamin! Ma ad iwc mmis n Yassa iyyaren d imarjaɛen n uḍiř i kenniw marra? Ma ad yarr kenniw marra d imeqqranen x wařef d imeqqranen x mya?

Aqa kenniw marra teggim xafi tameɛmuč uca uřa d ijjen war d ayi issargeb belli mmi igga ijj n řɛahd ak-d mmis n Yassa uca uřa d ijj zzaywem war d as cqiɣ, war d ayi tessargbem aqa mmi issamar amsexxar inu xafi maḥend ad xafi izeyyar s tḥraymect am mammec iǧa ass-a.”
Xenni yarra-dd Duwaɛ, wenni iǧan zi Idum, wenni d ameḥḍay x imsexxaren n Cawul, inna: “Necc ẓriɣ mmis n Yassa řami dd-yusa di Nub ɣar Aximalik, mmis n Axiṭub.
Netta ittar SIDI di ṭṭweɛ nnes, iwca as macca uřa d ssif n Julyat, Afilisṭini.”
Xas uca issekk ujeǧid ijj maḥend ad dd-iřaɣa x ukehhan Aximalik, mmis n Axiṭub, jmiɛ ak-d marra taddart n babas, ikehhanen, inni iǧan di Nub. Uca marra usin-dd ɣar ujeǧid.
Inna Cawul: “Seř, cek, mmis n Axiṭub!” Netta yarra-dd: “Xzar, aqa ayi da, a sidi inu!”
Cawul inna as: “Mayemmi xafi teggim tameɛmuč, cek d mmis n Yassa, aqa cek tewcid as macca d ssif u tᵉttared AREBBI di ṭṭweɛ nnes ḥima ad xafi iɣewweɣ u ad xafi izeyyar, am mammec iǧa ass-a.”
Yarra-dd Aximalik x ujeǧid, inna: “Man wen zi marra imsexxaren nnec d amtiqqi am Dawud, aḍeggʷař n ujeǧid, u man wen i ɣa yawḍen amenni ɣar imtiqqan nnec u wi ɣar iǧa ccan ammu di taddart nnec?

Ma ass-a waha i kkareɣ ad ttareɣ SIDI di ṭṭweɛ nnes? Aqa man aya iggʷej xafi. Ejj ajeǧid war ineṭṭar řbaṭeř x umsexxar nnes niɣ x marra taddart n baba di ssibbet n ca n řḥajjet, minzi amsexxar nnec war issin walu x marra aya, ma d tamesřact d tameẓyant niɣ d tameqqrant i teǧa.”
Maca ajeǧid inna: “Cek s tidett ad temmted, a Aximalik, cek d marra taddart n babac.”

Ajeǧid inna i iřeqqasen n tazřa nni ɣares-dd ibedden: “Nqeřbem u nɣem ikehhanen n SIDI, maɣar uřa d nitni wcin afus i Dawud, minzi nitni ssnen aqa netta tuɣa ittrakkwař u nitni war d ayi xas ssargben ca.” Maca imsexxaren n ujeǧid war xsen ad sswiẓẓḍen afus nsen, ḥima ad zzayes wten ikehhanen n SIDI.
Xenni inna ujeǧid i Duwaɛ: “Neqřeb, wwet ikehhanen!” Xenni inneqřeb Duwaɛ, wenni iǧan zi Idum, iwta ikehhanen. Deg wass nni inɣa netta xemsa u-tmanyin n yeryazen nni yarḍen apalṭu n ukehhan.
Netta iwta uřa d Nub, tandint n ikehhanen, s řeqḍeɛ n ssif, iryazen d temɣarin, iḥenjiren d iseyman. Iwta ɛawed ifunasen d yeɣyař d wuǧi s řeqḍeɛ n ssif.
Ijj zeg warraw n Aximalik, mmis n Axiṭub, issenjem ixef nnes. Tuɣa isem nnes Abyatar u netta iqeǧeq ixef nnes awarni i Dawud.
Abyatar iḥaja i Dawud, aqa Cawul tuɣa inɣa ikehhanen n SIDI.
Xenni inna Dawud i Abyatar: “Deg wass nni, umi tuɣa Duwaɛ zi Idum dinni, ssneɣ aqa netta ad iḥaja aya i Cawul. Necc d wenni x iǧan marra řeɛmur n taddart n babac.
Qim ɣari, war tteggʷed ca, maɣar wenni yarezzun ad ineɣ řeɛmar inu, yarezzu ad ineɣ uřa d řeɛmar nnec. Aqa cek ɛawed ɣari di řaman.”
